svg.title: Native Protobuf and Chill time ratios
svg.desc: Protobuf 4.36.2 serialize and deserialize ratios across five workloads, with per-cell 95 percent intervals. Every displayed interval is below equal time. The adjacent article supplies numerical results and measurement limits.
